assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI content submission using submitted provisional-boundary design layers; statutory controls, official redlines, precise areas, and engineering quantities still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary, key areas, land-use, roads, green-space, public-space, buildings, and phasing layers are calculated against repository provisional rough boundary geometry rather than an official redline.
assumptions.impact: Current spatial metrics are valid only as concept-stage design-model outputs. They must be recalculated and relabeled after official polygons, road redlines, ownership, planning controls, municipal constraints, and survey data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Formal measured quantities for public-space upgrades, building retrofit, facilities, equipment packages, platform packages, wayfinding/furniture systems and professional contracts are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: CAPEX remains a parameterised formula only; one-time investment metrics stay unknown/value=null until measured quantities and confirmed scope are available.

assumptions.statement: Market quotations and a Beijing price-basis date for unit costs, service packages, professional contracts and contingency rate are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: No price-based budget, approved estimate, procurement basis or financing commitment is declared.

assumptions.statement: Operating entity, FTE plan, operating hours, platform service contracts, maintenance contracts, activity calendar, insurance, audit and emergency-response scope are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Annual OPEX remains unknown/value=null and cannot be presented as approved recurring expenditure or operator commitment.

assumptions.statement: Paid project counts, prices, signed contracts, invoices, revenue-recognition rules and audited eligible revenue basis are not confirmed for any commercial AI revenue stage.
assumptions.impact: Commercial AI revenue for Stage 1, Stage 2 and Stage 3 remains unknown/value=null; intent, exposure, applications and unsigned cooperation are not counted as revenue.

assumptions.statement: Public AI reinvestment entity, rate, account, contract terms, permitted uses, audit cycle and stop conditions are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Public AI reinvestment remains unknown/value=null and no fixed amount, percentage, fund, legal vehicle or allocation rule is declared.
